title: Domogreen Research Platform
tagline: Secure research desktop suite (Flutter + Django REST)
intro: Product-led rebuild of Domogreen’s collaboration suite with Flutter desktop apps, Django REST services, and hardened hybrid infrastructure.
summary: Delivered Flutter desktop clients (Windows/macOS) backed by Django REST, Redis/WebSockets, JWT, and encryption—deployed across on-prem Linux and Google Cloud APIs. Earlier Flask/Firebase V1 artifacts were migrated into the new architecture before project deprecation.
features: Flutter desktop clients (Windows/macOS) with real-time collaboration
Django REST API with JWT, encryption, and granular RBAC
Hybrid deployment (on-prem Linux + Google Cloud services)

sections.title: Description
sections.body: Product-led rebuild of Domogreen’s collaboration suite with Flutter desktop clients, Django REST services, Redis/WebSockets, and hardened security layers.

sections.title: Objective / Aim
sections.body: Enable secure research collaboration with offline-ready desktop apps, encrypted data flows, and hybrid deployment flexibility.

sections.title: Role & Responsibilities
sections.body: Acted as product engineer: led roadmap conversations with the CEO, delivered Flutter desktop UX, architected Django REST services, and orchestrated data migrations from the Flask V1 stack.

sections.title: Features / Implementation
sections.body: Implemented JWT, encryption, and RBAC; built Redis/WebSockets collaboration; set up hybrid on-prem Linux + GCP infrastructure; enforced repository/service-layer patterns.

sections.title: Challenges & Solutions
sections.body: Balanced on-prem data residency with cloud scalability by splitting workloads, and hardened security through encryption and audit logging.

sections.title: Impact / Results
sections.body: Established secure architecture and reusable patterns later repurposed despite project discontinuation.

confidentialNotes: Deprecated project; retain only architectural takeaways.
